commonCompletedWorkerComparison.scope: Matched file/project instances from partial runs; source changes and host load differ, so command reductions are not a paired elapsed-time benchmark.

callerSourceVerification.scope: Completed worker reports only. Actual source equality and synchronous stack-shape verification; not initial runtime integrity, closure ownership or complete native coverage.

propertyWorkload.scope: Pinned source defaults and the baseline reports; tests and seed settings were not changed.

nextAction: Prototype a private pinned-Node native helper that validates the owned wrapper, inspects actual arguments, returns sanitized watched-field evidence and clears the wrapper in one Inspector call. Build only on GitHub and gate side-effect, proxy, receiver, foreign-exception, active-lifetime and complete-compilation regressions before full use. No breakpoint suppression or source filtering.
measurementScope: Partial completed-worker counts and inclusive command timings, not job elapsed time or CI savings. No complete observed phase or after comparison.
